title: Garu
text: Keep AI agents running on a schedule from one YAML file. Every tool call passes a policy you wrote (allow, ask, or block, by tool and by argument), every run is recorded and cost-capped, and anything that needs a yes waits in an inbox on your phone.

title: Reality Commit
text: Compare photos from site visits, label assets, and review proposed changes with verification notes. Save the history in your browser or export it as JSON.

title: DispatchTrack Lite
text: Create deliveries, assign drivers, resolve exceptions, and review delivery history. The public demo saves fictional records in your browser; the Java backend is a separate implementation.
stack: REACT · JAVA · REST APIs · LOCAL STORAGE

title: AWS Cloud Quest
text: Practice 50 cloud questions with shuffled answers, immediate feedback, and score and streak tracking. Runs directly in your browser.

title: STEDI Mobile
text: Mobile coursework covering onboarding screens, Bluetooth Low Energy connections, form inputs, and app builds with Expo EAS.

title: Serverless API
text: Java REST API work using AWS SAM, Lambda, and API Gateway, including endpoint integration and deployment troubleshooting.
stack: JAVA · AWS SAM · LAMBDA · API GATEWAY
